differing_lawful_witness.execution_source: selected_episode and parameter_rival calls for first retained seed

execution_method: Exact emitted (rule! (lambda (g) ...)) bytes are embedded in an expression with a lexical identity binding for callable-form rule!; the returned lambda is applied by the included RacketBridge. No Python label mirror.
limitations: Six settings and six seeds only; not a broad sampler or seed census.
Authored teaching grids use fixed 3x3 geometry and palette 5/7/8.
Identifiability is checked only against the five other declared settings per episode.
Palindromic teaching grids are excluded because they cannot identify first_tile.
Only the six closed-lambda programs are supported by the local registration wrapper.
No production parametric API or variant approval is implemented or implied.

parameters.input_constraints: 3x3; colors drawn from 5/7/8; at least one asymmetric row; teaching witnesses use all three colors
parameters.input_seed: seed // 6; shared within a six-seed comparison block
parameters.selection: SETTINGS[seed % 6], once for the whole episode

input-3.source: (rule! (lambda (g) (stack-grids 'horizontal (list g (flip-lr g) g (flip-lr g) g (flip-lr g)))))

mirror-3.source: (rule! (lambda (g) (stack-grids 'horizontal (list (flip-lr g) g (flip-lr g) g (flip-lr g) g))))

scope: PROPOSED task-local prototype; no canonical production or approval change
